entries.body_structure_used: flagship: cover (hero, editorial title+dek), overview (stat row + mini-TOC), capabilities (grouped grid), governance (officer cards), engage (contact + signoff) - per 08_document_doctrine flagship structure
entries.design_rationale: Built at Duke Demayo's direction to (1) extract a shared design-tokens/gssc-tokens.css single source of truth from the quotation master :root so all derivatives inherit rather than re-declare values, and (2) demonstrate a company_profile derivative on that shared layer ahead of a real client-facing version needed next week. Cover kept content-light (kicker+title+dek+3 stat pairs only) specifically to avoid the overflow the kernel already measured in Module 18's reverted budget-3 cover experiment. No new colors/fonts/tracking values introduced - all values sourced from the existing 17-color palette and 03_brand type scale.

entries.body_structure_used: flagship, revised: rebuilt v1's cover and every page's chrome onto the master's ACTUAL components (margin-rail, kicker, title, dek, caption-date, drop-cap lede, bt, pull/attrib, colophon) extracted via getComputedStyle against the real hydrated reference, added as design-tokens/gssc-components.css - a second shared layer alongside gssc-tokens.css
entries.is_novel_pattern: false - correction of v1, not a new pattern; the components themselves are the master's own, not new inventions
entries.design_rationale: Duke flagged that v1's cover did not match the master's premium density. Correct diagnosis: v1 only inherited the master's VALUES via gssc-tokens.css but reinvented parallel, thinner COMPONENTS instead of reusing the real ones. Fixed by measuring the real components off the rendered reference document and extracting them as gssc-components.css, then rebuilding every page on that vocabulary. Renamed the content wrapper to the master's own main.body so boxcheck can actually measure this document - caught a real gap: its flex-row estimator does not yet know .stat-row/.toc-list .row, giving a false-positive overflow on page 2. Confirmed false positive by direct render. The flex_row_classes config fix is left as open kernel work, not hand-patched here.
